request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied original game-model reference. A single full-body subject only, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor plane or ground shadow, no lettering, no caption, no border, no diagram, no contact sheet, no repeated views, no logo added outside the subject. Clean readable silhouette, detailed realistic game-model materials, restrained neutral studio illumination. Show a three-quarter front view with the subject oriented toward screen-right, camera level and minimal perspective distortion. The complete head, equipment, limbs and feet must fit; leave at least six percent transparent breathing room on every side. Preserve the reference's real anatomy, panel construction, proportions, asymmetric equipment and exact costume palette. Do not redesign or modernize. Subject: the adult Cerberus Nemesis soldier from Mass Effect 3, wearing the exact fully covered tactical uniform in the supplied front/side/back model sheet. Slender athletic human proportions, fitted black and charcoal armor and fabric, ochre mustard-gold diamond-quilted panels on the chest and central abdomen, fine gold trim on shoulder/arm panels and thigh straps, dark segmented long lower legs and metal forearm/shin accents. A fully closed elongated angular dark helmet with the LARGE SINGLE ROUND RED optical lens on its face, one tiny adjacent red indicator, pale blue-grey top inserts and circular grey side respirator fittings, no visible human face or hair. Preserve the asymmetrical helmet details from the reference rather than converting it into a generic visor. Exact harness and strap construction, utility pouch at outer thigh. Neutral standing character-inspection pose with arms slightly relaxed away from the body and hands empty so all torso details remain visible. No added gun, no laser line, no sniper scope, no cloth skirt or cape. Match the subtle silhouette and realistic proportions; no stylized exaggeration.
